full_name: Triton Gaming Fall General Body Meeting
name: Fall GBM
content: Kick off the fall quarter with Triton Gaming! Learn about our divisions, meet the exec board, and find out how you can get involved. Free giveaways and fun activities for all attendees.

name: Halloween Gaming Night
content: Dress up and game out! Join us for a spooky Halloween gaming night featuring costume contests, horror-themed games, free food, and prizes. Come as you are — no costume required!

name: Fall Tournament
content: Compete in our biggest fall tournament featuring Valorant, League of Legends, Smash Bros, and more. Cash prizes and sponsor giveaways for top finishers. Register through Discord.

name: Winter Lucky Draw
content: Our fan-favorite annual lucky draw is back! Win gaming peripherals, gift cards, Steam codes, and exclusive Triton Gaming merch. Free entry with valid UCSD student ID.

name: Spring LAN 2026
location: Price Center East Ballroom & Ballroom East
content: Our premier spring LAN event returns! Featuring PC gaming stations, console setups, artist alley, industry panels, sponsor booths, tournaments, and incredible giveaways. RSVP required.

name: TGEX 2026
content: The ultimate gaming expo at UC San Diego. TGEX features tournaments with cash prizes, celebrity streamers and esports pros, sponsor activations, artist alley, live music, and more. Don't miss it.

name: TGEX 2025
content: The Triton Gaming Expo brought together hundreds of UCSD students for a day of competitive gaming, sponsor activations, panels with industry professionals, and incredible giveaways.

name: Spring Games Expo
content: A chill spring gaming showcase with free-to-play setups, casual tournaments, food, and a great opportunity to connect with fellow gamers at UCSD.
